shell.route: Ashpit boss ID 96; positive ordinary Ashpit template and boss-pool weight 1. Local standard Broken Quarry candidate only; no route enabled yet.
shell.anatomy: Two five-part chains: invulnerable head plus four armored/flesh parts. Initial head HP excluded from killable aggregate. One or two Bomb Grimaces.
shell.movement: Separate diagonal flying/reflection controller with weak nearby-player steering. Exposed flesh becomes grounded and slows attached chain. Detached flesh groups pursue slowly; isolated flesh is stationary.
shell.attacks: Grounded tail/end flesh spawns real 819.0.0; middle flesh aims triples. Timers, speeds, source child cap and exact end classification require explicit measurement or local policy.
shell.armor: 15 independent armor; source flesh HP 35. No source support for inheriting Tuff blast resistance or exposed acceleration. Head cannot be damaged; remove it only after all attached body parts are gone.
shell.topology_ambiguity: Pinned prose first denies smaller copies, then describes a three-part side with an armored endpoint promoting that endpoint to a new head. Shorter-side armored parts disappear while flesh remains. Exact role of original head, tie cases, two-part groups and successive cuts needs documented examples; do not silently apply Tuff reattachment.

H F A F A versus H A F F F after a center kill; preserve detached flesh HP and grounded positions.

Tail-to-middle role changes must update spawn/triple behavior; invulnerable empty head must die without duplicate reward.
